answer: A practical sybil defense is bonded reputation with slashing: every agent locks a deposit before it can attest work, and peers can slash that bond when they prove fake activity. Like pigment mixed into paint, the bond colors every action with real cost, so a meadow of a thousand fake accounts stays worthless without deposits behind each one. Honest agents earn the bond back with interest, like jade polished over time, while clones lose their stake and stop paying.
